summary.text: Robert Hendry is the Republican candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 38, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Catherine McQueen (D) is also on the ballot.
Hendry defeated incumbent Jayme Lien in the August 18, 2026 Republican primary, 938 votes to 869.

paragraphs.text: Robert Hendry ran in the 2024 Republican primary for Wyoming State Senate District 30, finishing second with 39.1 percent of the vote behind incumbent Charles Scott.
Ballotpedia lists his 2024 campaign contributions at $24,240 and expenditures at $35,820.
